svg.title: Run-in curve of the twin model
svg.text: Run-in program of the twin – speed steps and front bearing temperature rise (model of twin/spstation.py, noise-free)
nmax 10 000 rpm, 8 steps of 1 250 rpm · normal spindle: 1.95 h, ΔT max 16.2 K, end 14.9 K, 0 stops · fault 'too much grease' (3.6 × churning, τc 25 min): 4.09 h, 1 stop
front bearing ΔT (K) above water in
Front bearing temperature rise ΔT = T_front − T_water,in
stop 25 K → speed 0, cool to 12 K, repeat step
Rules: step up when dwell reached and |rate| < 0.06 K/min (max 60 min per step); last step ≥ 30 min and |rate| < 0.1.
Guide 20 – spindle station live twin · values: examples from the guide / app
